findings: Question-bank integrity/source-alignment checks fail in these languages; per-record errors are listed below.
Independent learning-command cards are missing translations despite question-derived overlays; per-language missing IDs are listed below.
Games hub and multiple game screens use hardcoded English names, instructions, controls and completion popups.
Scheduled notification text, in-app notifications and their screen controls are constructed in English without a locale parameter.
Learning-screen search, filter and navigation copy has only English/Hindi/Marathi variants; other locales receive English.
The welcome headline and Settings title are localized, but account actions, guest labels, confirmations and errors remain English.
Shared level picker and daily reward dialogs still contain English labels and messages.
Unlock popup headings are localized, but achievement names/descriptions and theme names remain English.
Word Guess hints and Command Match descriptions are English-only; preserved technical command names do not justify untranslated prose.
Certificate wording and PDF report labels are English-only. Exported non-Latin font rendering is not certified by this audit.
Localized drawer entries open some English-titled screens, including Cloud Computing, Scripting and Challenge Mode.
Flutter built-in controls fall back to English or Urdu for locales not provided by Flutter, even though the app language is selectable.
Reviewed samples contain unchanged English answer prose inside non-English questions, including Hindi/Marathi banks that pass structural alignment checks.
Some UI bundles contain duplicate JSON keys; last-value-wins loading hides earlier text, including conflicting English values.
Automated harness: 95 passed, 0 failed. These counts do not measure translation completeness.
events: Audit started. Existing translation completion claims will be rechecked against current files.
Structural checks and native-language semantic review are separate. A test pass will not be represented as proof of translation accuracy.
English is included in the 32 selectable UI languages. Extra Korean question assets will be reported separately.
